morphology.pattern_note: sayur 是不可按 sa- 拆分的词根；meN- + sayur → menyayur，词首 s 在鼻音替换中脱落，形成 meny-。

senses.zh_definition: 蔬菜；可供食用的植物或其可食部分，如蕹菜、芥菜等。
senses.en_definition: Vegetables: edible plants or plant parts used as food.
senses.ms_definition: Tumbuhan atau bahagian tumbuhan yang boleh dimakan sebagai bahan makanan, seperti kangkung dan sawi.
senses.nuances: 日常可指一种或多种蔬菜，无须加复数标记。sayur-sayuran 可突出种类繁多。[DBP：sayur](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=109300&keyword=sayur)。

senses.zh_definition: 以蔬菜为主要材料烹制的菜肴，尤其指带汤汁的蔬菜菜肴。
senses.en_definition: A cooked vegetable dish, especially one served with broth or gravy.
senses.ms_definition: Masakan daripada sayur yang lazimnya berkuah.
senses.nuances: 不专指清汤；具体材料与烹调方式须结合菜名或上下文判断。[DBP：sayur](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=109300&keyword=sayur)。

dual_scenarios.context: 新闻 / 市场供应报道
dual_scenarios.ms: Bekalan sayur segar di pasar tersebut mencukupi untuk memenuhi permintaan penduduk setempat.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该市场的新鲜蔬菜供应充足，足以满足当地居民的需求。
dual_scenarios.en: The market has enough fresh vegetables to meet local demand.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Nak beli sayur apa kat pasar nanti?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Sayur apakah yang hendak kita beli di pasar nanti?
dual_scenarios.zh: 等下去市场买什么菜呀？
dual_scenarios.en: What vegetables should we get at the market later?
spoken_features: nak 对应 hendak，kat 对应 di。
口语可省略可由上下文确定的主语 kita。

messages.speaker: Farah (姐姐)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku nak pergi pasar. Sayur kat rumah dah habis ke?
messages.ms_standard: Saya hendak pergi ke pasar. Adakah sayur di rumah sudah habis?
messages.zh: 我要去市场。家里的菜吃完了吗？
messages.en: I am going to the market. Are we out of vegetables?

messages.speaker: Amir (弟弟)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah habis. Beli sawi je, nanti kita masak sup.
messages.ms_standard: Sayur sudah habis. Beli sawi sahaja; nanti kita akan memasak sup.
messages.zh: 吃完了。买点芥菜就行，等下煮汤。
messages.en: Yes, we are. Just get some mustard greens; we can make soup later.

etymology.historical_story: Sayur links the market basket with the cooking pot: Malay uses the same word for vegetables and for dishes made from them. This everyday connection explains why buying sayur and eating sayur can point to different stages of a meal. Its deeper historical origin is not established by the supplied packet, so no specific ancestral form is asserted here.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: sa.yur 分两拍，想象买菜后把“菜叶儿”放进锅里：sayur 既能是蔬菜，也能是煮好的蔬菜菜肴；谐音仅作记忆。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 在菜摊询价可说 Berapa harga sayur ini?；点餐时加上 boleh 或 tolong，语气更客气。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 含 sayur 的菜名不保证纯素；菜肴可能加入虾酱、江鱼仔、肉汤或其他动物性配料。有饮食限制时应具体询问材料。
